method:
Find a small middle-finger release offset from the actual supported C state.

Geometry only: no dynamic result is inferred. Source meshes and the existing
official mechanical exclusions are used, with no middle/tool exemption.
limitations: This is static source geometry at the actual cold final tool/body pose, not a physical release validation.
Closure shifts thumb/index joint values by the existing frozen closure_delta; jaw articulation remains an independent measured or sensitivity-swept transform.
Transition is checked at 11 uniform fractions for each of five closure values, not a continuous collision proof.
Jaw sensitivity rotates actual blade frames without changing their recorded positions; actual dynamic tool motion must be rechecked.
